run_fix_sitelinks: run the script to convert dict sitelinks to lists in the Wikidata MongoDB collection
run_write_updates: run write_updates to bulk write a batch of pymongo UpdateOne operations to the collection
review_write_updates: review the write_updates function that converts batch tuples into pymongo UpdateOne bulk writes
refactor_write_updates: refactor write_updates to accept the collection as a parameter instead of relying on a global
summarize_fix_sitelinks: summarize the fix_sitelinks script that iterates Wikidata documents and converts dict sitelinks to lists
